raw_sections.summary: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Capital Markets Operations professional with hands on experience in securities settlements across Euroclear and DTCC for equities and fixed income. Proficient in Position reconciliation, trade validation and settlement operations. Dedicated to delivering accurate, efficient and compliant operation.
raw_sections.education:
EDUCATION Vivekanand Education Society’s Business School Master of Business Administration – Finance Sharad Institute of Technology College of Engineering B. Tech – Electrical Engineering
Mumbai, Maharashtra July 2025 Ichalkaranji, Maharashtra July 2022
WORK EXPRIENCE Coforge Operations Analyst – Capital Markets & Client Reporting
Aug 2025 – Current • Managed settlement processes across Euroclear, FEDWIRE, and DTCC, ensuring seamless pre-matching, settlements, and reconciliations for equities and bonds while collaborating with trading desks and counterparties to resolve discrepancies and reduce trade breaks.
Performed daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliations in line with STP (Straight-Through Processing) standards, identifying exceptions, executing depot transfers, and ensuring accurate and compliant transactions within DTC and FED markets.
Supported creation and maintenance of client hierarchies by validating client/entity relationships and ensuring accurate mapping of client accounts within operational systems.
Handled client payments and settlement instructions (Static SSI) for new clients, while coordinating with the static data team to automate trade amendments and managing buy-ins to minimize settlement risk, operational costs, and financial exposure.
Performed client callbacks to independently verify and confirm Standing Settlement Instructions (SSI) before updating instructions in the system, following defined authentication and operational control procedures.
Verified trade instructions with Institution Managers, including validation of face value (original and current), price, principal, net amount, and account details to ensure accuracy in trade processing.
Processed trade settlements utilizing SWIFT Messaging standards with specific expertise in routing and managing MT541, MT543 and MT599 Messages. Verified mortgage factor updates using Bloomberg and processed SPO and wire adjustment in a timely manner.
Star India Pvt.Ltd(Jiostar) (Internship) Consultant- Sales Operations
December 25 – June 2025
Managed and maintained accurate client data across JioAds and Moloco platforms, ensuring 100% data integrity. • Collaborated with brands like MAHINDRA, Red Bull, TATA SONS and Malaysian Airlines to execute 95% of planned campaigns on time.
Scheduled and executed 50+ ad slots for high-profile events like BGT 24-25, Champions Trophy, WPL 2025 and IPL 2025, aligned with broadcast timelines.
Utilized Excel to create pivot summaries and reconciliation reports for performance tracking and data validation. • Collaborate with clients and internal teams via email communication to ensure a smooth process.
RevRoad (Internship) Venture Capital Deal Sourcing Extern
Mar 2024 – Apr 2024
Analyzed over 50 early-stage EdTech startups in the United States, identifying 10 high-potential investment opportunities with projected market growth of 14.6% CAGR.
Generated 5 detailed deal memos, incorporating market sizing, revenue projections, and SWOT analysis to support strategic investment decisions.
Conducted comparative analysis of startups, highlighting innovative solutions and strong team dynamics, resulting in 3 investment recommendations.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
•
